# devopser_outputs (Data Source)

Root outputs of another workspace (tfe_outputs). Needs an infra:admin key; reads are audited.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "devopser_outputs" "network" {
  workspace = "network"
}

output "vpc_id" {
  value = data.devopser_outputs.network.nonsensitive_values.vpc_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace` (String) Workspace name.

### Optional

- `organization` (String) Accepted for tfe compatibility and ignored.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The workspace id.
- `nonsensitive_values` (Dynamic) Only the outputs not marked sensitive.
- `values` (Dynamic, Sensitive) Every output, sensitive ones included.
